description.value: Neptune Barbecue House is a Cantonese restaurant on Granville Street in Vancouver, part of the multi-location Neptune Group established in 1997. The restaurant is well-known for its BBQ Pork, Roast Duck, and Party Tray Combos, and bills itself as one of the top Chinese restaurants in Greater Vancouver. Cyclists can order takeout directly through the website or via major delivery apps including DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Skip TheDishes.
